items.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021
items.q: I’m writing for that and Bill Cunliffe is writing for that

ctx.x: But you know to answer your question which is what’s on the horizon, I’m actually getting ready, next weekend my quintet is doing a live album recording at a club called Sam First. Now Sam First is inaugurating with this project, their own record label. Sam First Records. So we’re going to be their first project so I’m excited about that. I’m writing for that and Bill Cunliffe is writing for that, so the band is excited about getting together and just playing again. It’s been so long. So that’s on the horizon.…
Okay we’ll wrap up shortly. The guy at the cocktail party —
